verses.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: I said to the children of Israel, “When a woman conceives and gives birth to a son, she must cover herself for seven days after her menstrual period ends.”
verses.3: And on the eighth day, he will be circumcised.
verses.4: And for thirty days and six nights, he shall dwell in a state of purity. He shall not touch anything sacred during those days. He shall not enter the holy place until the end of those thirty days.
verses.5: And if a woman gives birth to a baby, and she will bathe her body as soon as it is clean. She must stay in a state of purity for sixty days.
verses.6: And after the days of purification are over, a son or a daughter shall be brought before the priest. The boy or girl shall be brought up in accordance with the laws of the Temple.
verses.7: And they brought it before Jehovah. They covered it with a cloth, so that it would be purified from its blood. This is the law for both the male and female offspring.
verses.8: And if she does not find any of her limbs, and she takes one of her sons to be sacrificed, or both sons to be sacrificed, then the priest shall sprinkle oil over her, and she will be purified.
